predecessors.name: Xiongnu
predecessors.text: 'a confederation of eight Xiongnu tribes in Bi's power base in the south ... seceded from Punu's kingdom'

successors.name: Cao Cao
successors.text: the Southern Xiongnu's frontier land in Shanxi, Shaanxi and Inner Mongolia, reorganized in 216 'into the Five Divisions'

ledger.x: 48: eight Xiongnu tribes in the south acclaim Bi as chanyu.
216: Cao Cao breaks the Southern Xiongnu into the Five Divisions.

wars.name: Southern Xiongnu against the Northern Xiongnu
wars.outcome: The Northern Xiongnu 'was dealt a heavy defeat' by the Southern in 49; the Southern Xiongnu allied with the Xianbei in 85 and marched with the Han in June 89 (Altai) and again in early 90 under chanyu Tuntuhe, who 'captured his rival's seal, treasure, wives…

certainty.note: A tributary people settled in Han frontier commanderies: the commandery lines are not on the pages opened, and the shape is Cliopatria's approximation.
